info.name: Student ID - University Record Service
info.description: 2026-11-12: these are the owned pre-migration Gateway checks. Record player reads authenticate the Gateway target credential before trusting identity headers; Postman must keep using Gateway with a real player JWT. The current CPR still marks Credential initialization incompatible. Owned 1.0.0 HTTP integration source candidate. Supply separate caller and management credentials only in a private local environment. All requests use Gateway baseUrl. Internal catalog operations require Gateway registry support and actual peer implementations; these checks do not certify whole-system readiness. Broker transport is not enabled. University Record merged Lab 3 source (0.4.0): run in order through Gateway http://localhost:8090 with a valid accessToken in a private local environment. Tracked tokens stay empty. Generates disposable student IDs, verifies CRUD, duplicate create/update 409 and rollback, sanitized 400/404 errors, 405 and cleanup. Record membership uses the configured real Gateway/Session integration; no runtime mock is supported. Internal /status, concurrent races, database faults, image provenance and full shared-stack acceptance are separate checks. Existing CPR image pins may predate these source changes.

item.name: Lab 4 Task 3 - Gateway boundary
item.description: Gateway public boundary checks. Keep baseUrl pointed at Gateway. The custom broker operational runtime does not yet transport these business calls.

request.description: Public Gateway relay for this service's existing health/readiness endpoint. Requires a running, healthy service and its database; this does not probe the custom broker.

exec: pm.test('Owned service health: HTTP 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Owned service reports UP', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql('UP'));

request.description: Explicit No Auth overrides the collection bearer token. Gateway must reject this request before forwarding it to the owned service.

exec: pm.test('Gateway rejects unauthorized access: HTTP 401', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));

pm.test('Gateway uses the existing authentication error contract', () => { const error = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(error.code).to.eql('UNAUTHENTICATED'); pm.expect(error.service).to.eql('gateway-service'); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('WWW-Authenticate')).to.eql('Bearer'); });

pm.test('Authentication error matches the response trace ID', () => { const traceId = pm.response.headers.get('X-Trace-Id'); pm.expect(traceId).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.traceId).to.eql(traceId); });

request.description: No Auth disables inherited authorization; the deliberately incomplete Bearer header contains no token. Gateway must return its existing 401 error.

exec: pm.test('Gateway rejects unauthorized access: HTTP 401', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));

pm.test('Gateway uses the existing authentication error contract', () => { const error = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(error.code).to.eql('UNAUTHENTICATED'); pm.expect(error.service).to.eql('gateway-service'); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('WWW-Authenticate')).to.eql('Bearer'); });

pm.test('Authentication error matches the response trace ID', () => { const traceId = pm.response.headers.get('X-Trace-Id'); pm.expect(traceId).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.traceId).to.eql(traceId); });
pm.collectionVariables.unset('recordId'); pm.collectionVariables.unset('recordConflictId');
const value = 'postman-record-' + pm.variables.replaceIn('{{$guid}}');
pm.collectionVariables.set('recordStudentId', value); pm.collectionVariables.set('recordOtherStudentId', value + '-other');
pm.test('Create disposable university record: HTTP 201', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));

pm.test('Created disposable record matches input', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.id).to.match(/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i); pm.expect(body.studentId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('recordStudentId')); pm.collectionVariables.set('recordId', body.id); });
pm.test('List includes created record: HTTP 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('Created ID is listed', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.some(row => row.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('recordId'))).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('Get by ID: HTTP 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Stored student ID matches', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().studentId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('recordStudentId')));
pm.test('Duplicate create is a conflict: HTTP 409', () => pm.response.to.have.status(409));

pm.test('Sanitized STUDENT_ID_CONFLICT error', () => { const error = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(error.code).to.eql('STUDENT_ID_CONFLICT'); pm.expect(error.service).to.eql('university-record-service'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('recordStudentId')); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include('Detail: Key'); });
pm.test('Create disposable conflict target: HTTP 201', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));

pm.test('Created disposable record matches input', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.id).to.match(/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i); pm.expect(body.studentId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('recordOtherStudentId')); pm.collectionVariables.set('recordConflictId', body.id); });
pm.test('Duplicate update is a conflict: HTTP 409', () => pm.response.to.have.status(409));

pm.test('Sanitized STUDENT_ID_CONFLICT error', () => { const error = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(error.code).to.eql('STUDENT_ID_CONFLICT'); pm.expect(error.service).to.eql('university-record-service'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('recordStudentId')); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include('Detail: Key'); });
pm.test('Conflict rollback preserves target: HTTP 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Conflicting update did not change student ID', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().studentId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('recordOtherStudentId')));
pm.test('Update original record: HTTP 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Updated name persisted', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().name).to.eql('Postman University Record Updated'));
pm.test('Get updated record: HTTP 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Read observes update', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().name).to.eql('Postman University Record Updated'));

item.name: Enrollment lookup with live Session permission

request.description: Requires the Gateway membership candidate: sessionId must name a real Session with explicit ENROLLMENT_LIST assigned to the player in accessToken. Gateway derives player identity from that JWT. See docs/gateway-membership-baseline.md. Legacy fixture IDs alone do not grant access.

exec: if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('sessionId')) { throw new Error('Set sessionId to a real Session granting this JWT player ENROLLMENT_LIST access.'); }
pm.test('Enrollment lookup with live Session permission: HTTP 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('Enrollment matches created record', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.found).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.studentId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('recordStudentId')); });

item.name: Enrollment lookup without membership is forbidden

exec: pm.test('Enrollment lookup without membership is forbidden: HTTP 403', () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));

pm.test('Sanitized RECORD_ACCESS_FORBIDDEN error', () => { const error = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(error.code).to.eql('RECORD_ACCESS_FORBIDDEN'); pm.expect(error.service).to.eql('university-record-service'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('recordStudentId')); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include('Detail: Key'); });
pm.test('Invalid input is rejected: HTTP 400', () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));
pm.test('Malformed JSON is rejected: HTTP 400', () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));

pm.test('Sanitized INVALID_REQUEST error', () => { const error = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(error.code).to.eql('INVALID_REQUEST'); pm.expect(error.service).to.eql('university-record-service'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('recordStudentId')); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include('Detail: Key'); });
pm.test('Missing record returns 404: HTTP 404', () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));

pm.test('Sanitized UNIVERSITY_RECORD_NOT_FOUND error', () => { const error = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(error.code).to.eql('UNIVERSITY_RECORD_NOT_FOUND'); pm.expect(error.service).to.eql('university-record-service'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('recordStudentId')); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include('Detail: Key'); });
pm.test('Unsupported method returns 405: HTTP 405', () => pm.response.to.have.status(405));
pm.test('Delete conflict target: HTTP 204', () => pm.response.to.have.status(204));
pm.test('Delete original record: HTTP 204', () => pm.response.to.have.status(204));
pm.test('Get deleted record returns 404: HTTP 404', () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));

pm.test('Sanitized UNIVERSITY_RECORD_NOT_FOUND error', () => { const error = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(error.code).to.eql('UNIVERSITY_RECORD_NOT_FOUND'); pm.expect(error.service).to.eql('university-record-service'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('recordStudentId')); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include('Detail: Key'); });

item.name: Lab 4 Task 4 - Operational logs
item.description: Start the local log-download endpoint for the exact running Compose project. Set logDownloadUrl and a private logDownloadToken; this is a separate operations credential, not the collection's Player JWT. The download is limited to this owned service and its declared numeric replicas. To download the whole system, omit the service query on the same endpoint.

exec: pm.test('Log exporter health: HTTP 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Exporter is UP', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.service).to.eql('log-download-service'); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('UP'); });

request.description: A finite text attachment from the selected Compose project. A 503 means the local Docker/configuration source is unavailable; it is not a successful empty log export.

exec: pm.test('Log download: HTTP 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('Private text attachment', () => { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.eql('text/plain; charset=utf-8'); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Disposition')).to.match(/^attachment; filename="student-id-logs-\d{8}T\d{6}Z\.log"$/); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Cache-Control')).to.eql('no-store'); });

pm.test('Owned service snapshot includes the requested bounds', () => { const text = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(text).to.include('services=university-record-service'); pm.expect(text).to.include('since=15m; tail=200 per container'); });
pm.test('Missing operations token: HTTP 401', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));

pm.test('Operations authentication error is traceable', () => { const error = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(error.code).to.eql('UNAUTHORIZED'); pm.expect(error.service).to.eql('log-download-service'); pm.expect(error.traceId).to.eql(pm.response.headers.get('X-Trace-Id')); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('WWW-Authenticate')).to.eql('Bearer'); });
pm.test('Invalid tail: HTTP 400', () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));

pm.test('Invalid query uses the operations contract', () => { const error = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(error.code).to.eql('INVALID_LOG_QUERY'); pm.expect(error.service).to.eql('log-download-service'); pm.expect(error.traceId).to.eql(pm.response.headers.get('X-Trace-Id')); });

item.name: Owned real HTTP integration candidate
item.description: Run against the reviewed Gateway registry and candidate service images. No X-Service-Name is supplied by this client: Gateway derives it from each distinct caller credential. Generation persists pending state; 202 is not a ready applicant. Supply initializationEnvelope only for receiver contract testing. Tokens remain empty in this export.

request.description: Authoritative persisted Record truth, accessible only to Credential and Rules using service identity. NOT_ENROLLED is enrolled=false and record=null; claimed identity is never rewritten to match truth.

exec: pm.test('Documented response', function() { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200]); });
pm.test('Trace correlation returned', function(){pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('X-Trace-Id')).to.eql(pm.variables.replaceIn('owned-postman-{{integrationRequestId}}'));});
pm.test('Negative truth is explicit',function(){var body=pm.response.json();pm.expect(body.enrolled).to.be.a('boolean');if(!body.enrolled)pm.expect(body.record).to.eql(null);});

request.description: Owned persisted HTTP baseline. Initialization consumers commit only their component and receipt, without republishing. Readiness checks both peer local receipts in parallel; missing, denied, malformed or unavailable peers keep the item pending.

exec: ['integrationApplicantId','integrationRequestId','unknownIntegrationId'].forEach(function(key){ if (!pm.collectionVariables.get(key)) pm.collectionVariables.set(key, pm.variables.replaceIn('{{$guid}}')); });
pm.test('Documented response', function() { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([202]); });
pm.test('Trace correlation returned', function(){pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('X-Trace-Id')).to.eql(pm.variables.replaceIn('owned-postman-{{integrationRequestId}}'));});

pm.test('Readiness is explicit',function(){ var body=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.ready).to.be.a('boolean'); if(pm.response.code===202) pm.expect(body.ready).to.eql(false); else pm.expect(body.ready).to.eql(true); });
